what_happened.line: The Finance Committee heard the town manager explain how the budget is built, from revenues and fixed costs to free cash, capital funding and outside grants.
A joint presentation meeting of the Finance Committee, Selectmen and School Committee was set for October 29 in the auditorium, with the time not yet set.
The committee set an Oct. 3 meeting at 6 p.m. to receive warrant articles and an Oct. 10 public hearing on the special Town Meeting warrant.
Members discussed police and fire staffing plans, overtime, the schools' reliance on state aid and a calendar for forecasts.
The only vote was on the prior minutes; the committee took no budget votes.

why_it_matters: The meeting laid out how the town sets its budget and what drives tax-supported costs such as public safety staffing and school funding, ahead of the special Town Meeting warrant that residents will be asked to vote on.
The Oct. 10 hearing and the joint meeting are the points where residents can hear the proposals and comment before Town Meeting.
